activity-rules-item1-content: Eligibility and Sign Up:This activity is open to all EasiCoin users. Users must click "Sign Up Now" on the event page.
activity-rules-item1-title: Bonus, Fee Credit Gold, Real Gold
activity-rules-item2-content: After completing registration, once your daily futures trading volume is ≥ 100,000 USDT, that day will count as one check-in day
activity-rules-item3-content: Trial Bonus & Fee Voucher Rewards: Users can claim the corresponding rewards on the campaign page after completing the required cumulative check-in days. Rewards will be automatically credited to their accounts within 24 hours after being claimed. To successfully redeem the Experience Bonus, users must maintain an available balance in their Futures Account of no less than the bonus amount
activity-rules-item4-content: Physical Reward Delivery: Users who complete 30 cumulative check-in days must submit their shipping address before the campaign ends. Rewards will be shipped within 7 business days after the campaign ends. Delivery is available only within mainland China (excluding Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and overseas regions). Physical rewards are non-transferable and cannot be redeemed for cash
activity-rules-item5-content: If multiple users participate from the same IP address, only the first participant is eligible for physical reward redemption.
activity-rules-item6-content: Violations & Final Interpretation: The following activities are strictly prohibited: wash trading, volume manipulation, self-trading, multi-account abuse, and any other fraudulent activities. Once a violation is verified, the platform reserves the right to revoke reward eligibility and reclaim any rewards already issued. EasiCoin reserves the right to the final interpretation of these rules. If you have any questions, please contact our official customer support
activity-rules-item7-content: EasiCoin reserves the right to make final interpretations of these terms and conditions, please contact us if you have any questions.
